notes: Programme pages redirect to the official Henley Business School (henley.ac.uk) and ICMA Centre (icmacentre.ac.uk) sub-sites; those were quoted. Only about 25 of the subject listings were crawled; remaining_urls are the subject listing pages not reached (their programmes are not listed individually). The China page gives 68% to 80% depending on university and programme with no per-class mapping, so china_requirement is text only and attached only where the programme page points to country-specific information. The detailed China PDF (china-pgt-entry-requirement-may-24.pdf) has no extractable text in the snapshot, so nothing was quoted from it. Henley/ICMA application dates (1 July / 1 August) carry no year, so no deadlines recorded. Henley MSc Coaching for Behavioural Change page states no requirements and was skipped; PGCE, PGCert, PGDip, MRes and Malaysia programmes were skipped.
